unfair_advantage: Proprietary technology and expertise in the industrial sector, as well as a strong brand and customer relationships.
milestone_1: Achieve $10 million in revenue within the next 12-18 months.
milestone_2: Expand product offerings to include at least 5 new industrial solutions within the next 24-30 months.
milestone_3: Establish a strong presence in at least 3 new international markets within the next 36-42 months.
kill_risk: Failure to adapt to changes in the industrial sector and loss of market share.
thesis_summary: DNOW Inc. has a strong brand and customer relationships, but faces challenges in the industrial sector.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to achieve revenue growth of at least 10% YoY for 3 consecutive years.
ten_k_highlights: The Company's revenue has fallen by 35.5% over the past 5 years.
The Company's gross margin has been insufficient, and its return on invested capital (ROIC) has fallen by 357.5% over the past 5 years.
The Company's share count has risen by 68.3% over the past 5 years, resulting in severe dilution.
valuation_note: FCF yield 2.1%, PEG 0.2, EV/EBITDA 22 — fairly valued for its growth.
